baseline_prompt_en: Create a cinematic couture-process photograph of an adult fictional woman whose general appearance follows the attached portrait: long center-parted dark wavy hair, brown eyes, a softly oval facial outline, natural brows, and composed focus. At dawn inside an abandoned planetarium converted into a fitting room, she stands as the client-performer for a zero-gravity stage work while two adult artisans shape her individual basted toile. Pins, chalked balance lines, and temporary seams show live fit corrections across the bodice and hip. One artisan hand-drapes a translucent silk layer while a deliberately opened side section reveals internal canvas, boning, organza support, and layered understructure. The second artisan hand-attaches one small embroidered constellation to the same developing garment. Frame the woman's full working silhouette, both artisans' hands, the toile, exposed construction, and embroidery contact in one readable three-quarter scene, with the old star projector casting moving constellations through cool dawn haze and warm atelier lamps.
